name: Mp Engine
description: Windows MDM settings in the Mp Engine category, applied as OMA-URI (SyncML) values.

properties.name: Enable file hash computation feature
properties.description:
Enable or disable file hash computation feature.

 Enabled:
 When this feature is enabled Microsoft Defender will compute hash value for files it scans.

 Disabled:
 File hash value is not computed
 
 Not configured:
 Same as Disabled.
